quarterstaff.name: Quarterstaff
quarterstaff.description: A walking staff and simple bludgeon.

spear.name: Spear
spear.description: A short spear with an ash shaft.

shortbow.name: Shortbow
shortbow.description: A simple ranged weapon. Requires two hands.

longbow.description: A martial ranged weapon. Requires two hands.

greatsword.name: Greatsword
greatsword.description: A heavy martial weapon. Requires two hands.

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: Adds +2 AC. Requires a free hand.

arcane_focus.description: A focus for wizard spellcasting. +1 Intelligence on expedition checks.

trail_map.description: A survey of tracks and waterways. +1 Wisdom on expedition checks.

climbers_kit.name: Climber’s kit
climbers_kit.description: Rope, harness, and pitons. +1 Strength on expedition checks.

thieves_tools.name: Thieves’ tools
thieves_tools.description: Picks, files, and fine probes. +1 Dexterity on expedition checks.

envoy_badge.name: Envoy’s badge
envoy_badge.description: A sign of trust from the Alderford council. +2 Charisma on expedition checks.
